async function save(x) {}

// CASE js_callback_comment_for expect=pass
async function c2(ids, register) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    register(async () => {
      // Replaces for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) in the old code
      await save(id);
    });
  }
}

// CASE js_toplevel_comment_for expect=pass
async function c5() {
  // Old code: for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
  await save(1);
}

// CASE js_toplevel_string_for expect=pass
async function c6() {
  const code = "for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {";
  await save(code);
}

// CASE js_word_for expect=pass
async function c7() {
  // Wait for (at most) one second; then retry once; if it fails, stop
  await save(1);
}

// CASE js_word_for_text expect=pass
async function c8(x) {
  const msg = `Looking for (${x}); found; done`;
  await save(msg);
}
